reasons: Claimed status is compliant: no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant binds the Client in the cited paragraphs, matching the rule's preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer).

Cited text supports the rationale: §8(c) references 'employees' only for access restriction, and §8(d)'s cross-reference to the separate Non-Competition Agreement is scoped to TrueLink's licence to use Credit Data, not to hiring of personnel.
No redline or comment is expected or present for a compliant finding; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs, which is correct here.
Failed deterministic checks (duration ≤12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are expected artifacts of there being no non-solicit clause at all, not evidence of a defect.
Note for reviewers: the separate Non-Competition Agreement is outside this document, so any hiring restriction living there would not be captured by this finding.
